content.text:
Unrelated change. This confirms `251ad374cb1027de108590bef75508f4f497b375` is the sole commit introducing the encoding regression that `c395707` fixes.

## Bug-Introducing Commits
BIC: 251ad374cb1027de108590bef75508f4f497b375

## Reasoning

**(1) Investigation:** I ran `git log` on the files touched by the fix (`IReportProperties.java`, `ReportProperties.java`, and the three `ReportGenerator.java` files). Only two commits in history ever modified `IReportProperties.java`/`ReportProperties.java`: the fix itself (`c395707`) and an earlier commit `251ad37` ("addition parameters by terry"). I diffed `251ad37` and found it is almost an exact mirror-image of the fix — it's the commit that originally introduced `OUTPUT_ENCODING`/`SOURCE_ENCODING` and removed the previously-working `OUT_ENCODING` wiring.

**(2) The introduced bug:** Before `251ad37`, `ReportProperties.parse()` read a single well-defined property `IReportProperties.OUT_ENCODING` ("out.encoding", exposed to users as `report.<type>.out.encoding`) into `m_outEncoding`, and this had corresponding defaults in `emma_default.properties` (`report.html.out.encoding: ISO-8859-1`, `report.xml.out.encoding: UTF-8`). Commit `251ad37`:
- Removed the `setOutEncoding`/`getOutEncoding`/`m_outEncoding` plumbing entirely.
- Added two new, non-standard property keys `OUTPUT_ENCODING = "html.outputEncoding"` and `SOURCE_ENCODING = "html.sourceEncoding"`, and switched all call sites (html/txt/xml `ReportGenerator`) to use `getOutputEncoding()` instead of `getOutEncoding()`.
- Added `$assert.ASSERT (m_sourceEncoding != null, ...)` and `$assert.ASSERT (m_outputEncoding != null, ...)` in `validate()`, while still parsing these new properties with `getReportProperty(..., false, false)` — i.e., **no default value**.

Since `emma_default.properties` only defines defaults for the old `out.encoding` key (never updated to the new `html.outputEncoding`/`html.sourceEncoding` names), and nothing else in the codebase sets these new properties, `getOutputEncoding()`/`getSourceEncoding()` return `null` under normal/default usage. This breaks report generation in two ways: the configured/default output encoding (ISO-8859-1 for HTML, UTF-8 for XML) is silently ignored, and the new `ASSERT` calls will fail with an `AssertionError` whenever assertions are enabled, since the asserted fields are null by default.

**(3) Evidence:**
- `emma_default.properties:97` still has `report.html.out.encoding: ISO-8859-1` (stale default tied to the removed `OUT_ENCODING` property, orphaned after `251ad37`).
- The fix commit `c395707` precisely reverts `251ad37`'s renaming: it restores `OUT_ENCODING`/adds `IN_ENCODING`, removes `OUTPUT_ENCODING`/`SOURCE_ENCODING`, removes the problematic null-asserts, and updates all the same call sites back to `getOutEncoding()`/`getInEncoding()`.
- No other commit between `251ad37` and `c395707` touched `IReportProperties.java` or `ReportProperties.java` (confirmed via `git log` on those paths), so no intermediate commit could have introduced or masked this regression.

I'm highly confident `251ad37` is the bug-introducing commit; there is no ambiguity since it's the only prior commit touching the exact properties the fix reverts.
